campaignScope: Media PDP-0 coordinator mapping recommendation for canonical capability source-order leaves 155–308 inclusive.
mappingMethod: Assign one primary A–Q cluster by closest blueprint §2 user-visible intent; retain a related cluster only for a material secondary fit. Every scoped capability leaf is TARGET. Recommendations do not assert owner acceptance, capability implementation, qualification, runtime availability, or release readiness.
